EditorMetadata.Description: P1b (Hill-attack -> Blueprints migration, wave-core slice, architect Architect_Question_8_Wave_Core.md): Action_DispatchWaveWithTargets rebuilt as a visually-authored AiPrimitive BTreeAction, exercising a P1b in-body Branch NESTED inside another in-body Branch (Branch2 inside Branch1.True) inside a FlowForEach body -- the P1b in-body scheduling extended to depth 2. Graph (see docs/blueprints/WaveCore_Slice_Design.md for the full oracle-line->node table): EventEntry -> SetVariable(Runners <- MemberSlotListOps.Empty()) -> SetVariable(WaveUsedSlotsMask <- Literal (ushort)0) -> FlowForEach over the commander's UnitRoster (curated UnitRosterOps.Count/Subordinate). Body -> Branch1(Condition <- WaveDispatchOps.ShouldConsider(sub<-CurrentItem, trackerCount<-MemberSlotListOps.Count(Runners), rosterCount<-FlowForEach.Count, currentWave<-CurrentWave)) [bundles the oracle's tracker-full + IsAlive + wave-parity skip conditions into one visual condition, architect Q#8-B/E, so the FlowForEach body needs only 2 nesting levels instead of 4]. Branch1.True -> Branch2(Condition <- Compare(SlotOps.PickRandomFreeSlot(BurnedSlotsMask, WaveUsedSlotsMask, TotalSlots, CurrentWave) != -1, NotEqual)) [PickRandomFreeSlot is PURE despite consuming self+view -- a deterministic seeded pick, architect Q#8-C, replacing Random.Shared for replay/rollback/headless-proof determinism]. Branch2.True: computes the firing-slot world position (SegmentMath.LerpParam/Lerp), the closest baseline slot (SlotOps.PickClosestBaselineSlot) and its world position, the round-robin target NetworkId (TargetPoolOps.ResolveNetId), and the HullDownAttackParams JSON payload (HullDownIntentJson.Build) -> PublishEvent(AssignTacticalIntentEvent; IntentId="HullDownAttack") -> SetVariable(Runners <- MemberSlotListOps.AddRunner) -> SetVariable(WaveUsedSlotsMask <- MaskOps.WithBitSet) -> SetVariable(BaselineReservedMask <- MaskOps.WithBitSet). Branch1.False and Branch2.False are both UNWIRED (tank skipped this wave). A single GetVariable(Runners) node (and one GetVariable per other WorkingState field read in the body) feeds every pre-mutation consumer via pure fan-out, exactly as documented by HillAssault2_RequestAreaQuery. FlowForEach.Completed -> SetVariable(CachedTargetGroupHandle <- -1) -> AreaQueryBatchOps.Free(CachedEqsRequestId) [IsPure=false/EXEC so the side effect is never DCE'd, architect Q#7-D precedent] -> SetVariable(CachedEqsRequestId <- -1L) -> SetVariable(EqsRequestTime <- 0f) -> SetVariable(CurrentWave <- WaveParityOps.NextWave(CurrentWave)) -> Return(Success). DEVIATION 1 (documented): the oracle's leading 'if (!HasComponent<UnitRoster>(Self)) { ...; return Success }' guard is omitted -- the FlowForEach lowering reads the UnitRoster on self unconditionally, exactly as HillAssault2_DispatchAllToBaseline already does. DEVIATION 2 (documented): the oracle's BehaviorLog.IsDebugEnabled/Warn diagnostic logging calls are not reproduced (debug-only side channel, no bearing on WorkingState/return-status/published-event behavior). New curated helpers: WaveDispatchOps.ShouldConsider, SlotOps.PickRandomFreeSlot/PickClosestBaselineSlot, TargetPoolOps.ResolveNetId, HullDownIntentJson.Build, WaveParityOps.NextWave (architect Q#8-A/B/C/E). Reuses SegmentMath.LerpParam/Lerp and MaskOps.WithBitSet from HillAssault2_DispatchAllToBaseline. Does not modify the C# oracle (HillAttackCommanderNodes.Action_DispatchWaveWithTargets, line 287-437) or the compiler.
